title: Satellites shake over Roraima's rare earths

tellings.quote: So it is believed that when these American satellites that can perform these scannings searching for minerals all over the planet when they cross over the state of Hima, the signal is so strong from the presence of rare earth that the satellite shakes violently almost to the point of dropping

plain: American satellites that scan the planet for minerals are said to shake violently, "almost to the point of dropping," when they pass over Roraima, a state in northern Brazil, because the signal from the rare earths in its ground is so strong. Rare earths are scarce metals used in modern electronics. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defence minister, passes this on as something that "is believed," a way of saying how rich and strategically important that land would be.
